Project Management Certification.
Technical Classes or Certifications.
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Direct experience overseeing complex enterprise SaaS portfolios (e.g., DocuSign, Qualtrics, Google Workspace, or similar platforms) and guiding technical teams in solution delivery.
Proven experience defining testing strategy and overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) executed by technical teams for system deployments or major upgrades.
Proven experience planning and executing the operational handoff of new services or features from project phase into ongoing ITSM operations.
Experience directing and overseeing technical documentation, knowledge base content, and operational training/coaching for Service Desk and technical staff.

This position applies advanced IT professional concepts and campus objectives to identify solutions to highly complex issues and client requirements across multiple areas of information technology specialization. This position independently researches and recommends solutions that require an in-depth evaluation of variable functional, technical, process, and policy factors.

The successful candidate is a versatile IT professional capable of straddling IT service management, technical project management, strategic application oversight, and client engagement. They build strong relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the university, facilitate user communities of practice, serve as a strategic bridge between clients, vendors, and technical teams, and manage services with campus-wide impact. Leveraging deep technical comprehension of application architecture, system configurations, and code modifications, they critically evaluate technical options and direct technical teams in delivering solutions. This role takes independent responsibility for service, project, and application portfolio governance to ensure the stability, security, and functional fit of enterprise SaaS applications while collaborating within a service team to achieve shared portfolio goals.
Track record of proactively engaging campus clients and leaders to identify service gaps and translate evolving business needs into technical solutions.
Advanced understanding of SaaS and cloud-native application deployment, configuration, system architecture, code modification impacts, security, SSO/SAML/LDAP protocols, and integration principles.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.
This is a fully remote position, and the selected candidate must be able to work successfully from a home/remote office and be able to fulfill the requirements of the UCSC telecommuting agreement.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.

The University of California has implemented a Vaccination Policy covering all employees. Employees, including new hires, are required to comply with any applicable policies relating to the University of California vaccine program.

Per the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA), this position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter. The selected candidate will be required to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect as defined by CANRA and will be required to sign a Statement Acknowledging Requirement to Report Child Abuse prior to commencing employment. CANRA Penal Codes, and related definitions, requirements, and responsibilities may be obtained here.
Advanced knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including the ITIL framework and Service Lifecycle components (Incident, Request, Change, and Problem Management governance).
Knowledge of key higher education regulations and policies impacting IT services and data, such as FERPA, ADA, and institutional Information Security Policies.
Ability to work long periods of time at a computer with or without accommodation.
Comprehensive knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile/Hybrid), including WBS, resource planning, and risk management techniques.
In-depth knowledge of techniques for service analysis, functional needs assessment, vendor release roadmap evaluation, and emerging SaaS capability assessment.
Knowledge of best practices for managing vendor relationships, coordinating contract reviews, and monitoring service level performance.
Skill in translating organizational goals into service roadmaps, lifecycle plans, and formal solution proposals for executive leadership.
Advanced analytical skill to evaluate how complex system configurations, code changes, and data integrations affect connected systems, data security, and operational workflows.
Skill in defining, negotiating, monitoring, and reporting on Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Proven skill in directing and guiding technical teams, delegating execution tasks, serving as a senior technical escalation resource, and leading cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
Outstanding communication and relationship management skills to serve as a strategic bridge across technical, administrative, and executive audiences.
Skill in designing and modifying complex operational processes and procedures for continuous service improvement and workflow optimization.
Skill in managing the full change lifecycle, including impact analysis, risk mitigation, and production deployment authorization for projects and operations.
